title: Ferrers Boards
key_idea: A **Ferrers board** $B(b_1, \ldots, b_n)$ is the board with $b_i$ cells in column $i$ (staircase-shaped). The rook numbers $r_k$ for Ferrers boards have a clean product formula, giving a factored rook polynomial. This connects to the theory of hit polynomials and the falling factorial expansion of the rook polynomial.
